laws.rule: Waterberg Plateau Park: MEFT says booking is required for guided AND unguided hiking trails on the plateau; short walking trails within the resort are separately mentioned. Do not treat every short resort walk as requiring a plateau-trail booking. Actual available trails and dates must be confirmed.
